scenes.title: Opening joy
scenes.action: Original humanoid Quant AI robot and compact partner join laughing human-inspired quant avatars; glossy Oracle Octaves world.

scenes.title: Meet the crowd
scenes.action: Quants from across a luminous world map converge into a lively crowd, each carrying distinct data.

scenes.title: One quant
scenes.action: Focus on one individual quant and its own source-linked data card.

scenes.title: Another quant
scenes.action: Cut to a different quant and its distinct data card; do not duplicate the first.

scenes.title: Share the love
scenes.action: Show users tapping the real Share and Collect controls; useful information passes between connected hands.

scenes.title: R.E.M. portrait beat
scenes.action: Show R.E.M. using an approved band visual when available; retain a clearly labeled placeholder until supplied.

scenes.title: Kris portrait beat
scenes.action: Show Kris using his approved portrait, without inventing his likeness or substituting another person.

scenes.title: Into town
scenes.action: Transition from connected data to regular commerce: merchant cards, storefronts and owner-reviewed inventory/order drafts.

scenes.title: Happy: no bars
scenes.action: An open, welcoming scene without bars; preserve the owner’s literal visual direction.

scenes.title: Happy: no gas
scenes.action: A light, clean scene without gas-pump imagery; use the motif symbolically rather than claiming a deployed fuel-free product.

scenes.title: Plant the data
scenes.action: Place collected quants into the fields of the user’s page, like planting a garden.

scenes.title: A new item grows
scenes.action: Extracted data blossoms into a useful product card and a new proposed item in a store; show source links and owner review.

scenes.title: Infinity Platinum shines
scenes.action: Gold and silver reflections reveal the Infinity Platinum browser concept with a polished platinum finish. Use the word Infinity, not an infinity symbol.

scenes.title: Connected hands · first
scenes.action: Quants and users join hands through the owner’s own Infinity/Quant AI connections; show original independent architecture.

scenes.title: Connected hands · second
scenes.action: Widen the connected circle; every quant remains individual while linked to others.

scenes.title: Laugh together
scenes.action: Crowd laughs as useful cards appear among the linked quants.

scenes.title: Everyone around
scenes.action: Pull back to the whole crowd: people, small businesses, researchers and their distinct quants.

scenes.title: Love them · first
scenes.action: A user collects another participant’s helpful card with visible attribution.

scenes.title: Love them · second
scenes.action: Another user shares a useful card, retaining its source and owner.

scenes.title: Put it in your hands
scenes.action: A finished usable card arrives in the user’s hands and personal project field.

scenes.title: Take it · first
scenes.action: Move the card into the personal workspace using the real project handoff.

scenes.title: Take it · second
scenes.action: Move an owner-approved proposal toward the business inventory workflow.

scenes.title: Keep the joy
scenes.action: A gentle uplifting transition: replace a frustrating empty field with an understandable result; avoid invented service guarantees.

scenes.title: Happy again · first
scenes.action: Users celebrate a useful result in a clear open scene.

scenes.title: Happy again · second
scenes.action: The robots join the joyful crowd and send Bubbles specialists toward the next useful task.

scenes.title: Tomorrow shines
scenes.action: Place the useful information in a glowing heart-shaped network, then reveal tomorrow’s page and a growing store.

scenes.title: Platinum returns
scenes.action: Return to gold, silver and platinum reflections around the Infinity Platinum concept.

scenes.title: Hands together · return 1
scenes.action: A fresh set of quants joins the independent Infinity connections.

scenes.title: Hands together · return 2
scenes.action: Follow one connection from source data to card to merchant.

scenes.title: Laughter returns
scenes.action: Users and quant avatars laugh together.

scenes.title: Here we go
scenes.action: The lead robot opens the switchboard; Bubbles specialists fan out in time with the music.

scenes.title: Final chorus · hands 1
scenes.action: Connect individual quants into a sweeping ring around the lead robot.

scenes.title: Final chorus · hands 2
scenes.action: Pass useful cards through the ring, preserving identities and attribution.

scenes.title: Final chorus · laughter 1
scenes.action: Cut to joyful participants and the compact robot partner.

scenes.title: Final chorus · hands 3
scenes.action: Reconnect crowd, page fields and commerce with a new camera angle.

scenes.title: Final chorus · hands 4
scenes.action: Show the original Infinity connection network as an independent alternative; do not invent Google or Microsoft partnership or endorsement.

scenes.title: Final chorus · laughter 2
scenes.action: Users laugh while new product-card flowers open.

scenes.title: Response · hands 1
scenes.action: Show one quant, then the next, joining hands.

scenes.title: Response · hands 2
scenes.action: Widen from individual data to the connected crowd.

scenes.title: Response · laughter 1
scenes.action: Celebrate the owner-reviewed output of useful business data.

scenes.title: Response · hands 3
scenes.action: Join people and their own project fields in one continuous connection.

scenes.title: Response · laughter 2
scenes.lyric_marker: laughing · people and happy people response
scenes.action: Alternate crowd laughter, Bubbles specialists and flowering inventory cards.

scenes.title: Response · hands 4
scenes.action: Bring the whole independent network together beneath Quant AI branding.

scenes.title: Happy people · close
scenes.action: End with the joyful connected crowd, Quant AI — Automated Banking & Business Agent, Oracle AI Studio, Created by Mosaic.

jobs.title: Update Quant AI music-driven presentation
jobs.instructions: Read production/quant-ai-commercial.json v2. Use the owner’s selected Shiny Happy People direction and all 44 ordered visual cues. Oracle Octaves styling is required. Keep the humanoid business lead, compact partner and Bubbles specialists. Explicitly target the full repository executor with executor=repository-engine; this is not a robot-directions.js interface repair. Create or update quant-ai-presentation.html, quant-ai-presentation.js and quant-ai-presentation.css from the saved cue list. Show readable scene cards, original independent Infinity Platinum concept, distinct individual quants, Share/Collect, commerce, planted page fields and new inventory proposals. R.E.M. and Kris visual beats use labeled placeholders until their approved assets are attached. Add test/quant-ai-presentation.test.cjs verifying cue order, product branding, next/previous and keyboard controls. Do not edit robot-directions.js, wallet logic or existing studio files. No external slideshow provider or pptx is required.
acceptance: All 44 saved visual cues represented in order
Playable presentation navigation and exact product branding
Executable focused tests pass; label source/deployment evidence separately

jobs.title: Build Quant AI song-cue video timeline
jobs.instructions: Read production/quant-ai-commercial.json v2. Use the owner’s selected Shiny Happy People direction and all 44 ordered visual cues. Oracle Octaves styling is required. Keep the humanoid business lead, compact partner and Bubbles specialists. Explicitly target the full repository executor with executor=repository-engine; this is not a robot-directions.js interface repair. Create or update quant-ai-commercial.html and quant-ai-commercial.js. Use the full ordered song-cue sequence and support editable cue marks plus an uploaded authorized audio track. Retain a clearly labeled silent 35-second scene-order draft when audio is absent; do not imply it is song-synchronized. Once audio is supplied, derive duration from actual loaded metadata and align configured cue marks; do not guess song timings. Implement original scene animation, preview, cancellation and real MediaRecorder export through cinema-reel-core.js. Use readable real-font captions with product/cue names rather than publishing the full lyrics. Preserve all repeated hands/laughter motifs with camera/participant variation. Band and Kris beats remain placeholders until approved visual assets are attached. Add test/quant-ai-commercial.test.cjs for ordered cues, missing-audio status, cue timing validation and export lifecycle. Do not download the song, add invented artist vocals, claim Google/Microsoft partnership or edit wallet/robot-directions.js.
acceptance: All saved cues included, with deliberate repeated chorus variation
Audio absence remains explicit; attached audio drives real duration and validated timing
Preview/cancel/export code and executable focused tests pass

jobs.title: Verify Quant AI music-direction scenes and export
jobs.instructions: Read production/quant-ai-commercial.json v2. Use the owner’s selected Shiny Happy People direction and all 44 ordered visual cues. Oracle Octaves styling is required. story_arc: Individual quants → a connected crowd → sharing and collecting → commerce → planted page fields → extracted data → proposed new inventory → Infinity Platinum → joined hands and joy.

required_assets.subject: Real Share / Collect / project / commerce controls

visual_notes: Oracle Octaves throughout: clean warm-white rounded surfaces, cyan-blue-violet glass, and polished gold/silver/platinum accents.
Keep the original humanoid Quant AI lead and compact robot partner as guides; Bubbles remains its specialist team.
The hands sequence represents owner-controlled connections and browser choice. No third-party endorsement is asserted.
Map bars and gas motifs literally and symbolically; no unverified financial or energy claims.
